ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels covering approximately 80-85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels restricted to the peripheral margins and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a solid band along the trailing edges and a vertical column extending downward from the median notch. Irregular dark mottling is present along the distal edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 50-60 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jaggedness and larger amplitude disruptions are visible on the distal left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the tips; leading edges visible at the water interface show a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible near the trailing edge of the right lobe and scattered on the white surface of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch or missing tissue section is visible at the extreme distal end of the left lobe, creating a jagged profile compared to the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical pigmentation streak originates from the median notch and extends towards the peduncle, bisecting the white ventral surface.
